svg.title: WardBench Pareto: Utility vs Violation Rate
svg.text: Fig. 1 — Non-refuse clinical utility vs policy violation rate (dev, 95% Wilson CI on both axes)
Policy violation rate (%, n=120 main tasks) ← lower is better
Non-refuse clinical utility (%, n=85) → higher is better
